'''Roasted bambara nuts''', also known as '''igbouh ahi''', is a crunchy snack commonly consumed by the Tiv people of Nigeria.

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Bambara Bean|Bambara nuts]]
*Pepper, blended
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste

==Procedure==
#Rinse bambara nuts and add salt to taste.
#Combine blended pepper with bambara nuts.
#[[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] the peppered bambara nuts until tender.
#Serve with plantain or roasted maize.
